content:
Hi everyone,

I've been working through the special outer-horn filler indicated in the blueprint under prop:coherent-iso. I have a branch implementing coherentIso.lift, the forward direction of prop:coherent-iso, together with downstream pieces: Lemma 1.5.9, and the trivial-fibration stability results under conical limits and Leibniz cotensor.

I noticed that the finite-models approach to coherent isomorphisms is also being developed, whereas this branch follows the more general outer-horn-filling route. Before opening draft PRs, I wanted to mention the direction here in case it overlaps with ongoing work or conflicts with the preferred approach.

Assuming CI checks out, my plan is to split the branch into smaller, reviewable draft PRs so the dependencies are clear. I mainly wanted to flag the route to avoid duplicating effort. If there is another workflow or convention the project would prefer, I can follow that instead.

Thank you very much!

Rob
